name: What documents do I need for a pre-construction assignment sale?

mainEntity.name: What documents do I need for a pre-construction assignment sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a pre-construction assignment sale, you will need the original Agreement of Purchase and Sale, any amendments to that agreement, and a separate Assignment Agreement. You may also need financial documentation for the developer's approval. For sellers (assignors), having a clear record of deposits paid is crucial. Kelby Contreras can guide you through gathering and preparing all necessary documentation, ensuring compliance with developer requirements and facilitating a smooth transaction.
